firstPlayerRule: Nobody goes first: when both players are ready, one or both say “Spit!” and each places a card at the same time.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/, a scan with no text layer, rendered it to an image and read it. PDF page 1: "Play: When you’re both ready to go, one or both of you says, ‘Spit!’ and you each place one card from your pack face-up between your rows."
